description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Garen''' [[File:Remove Scurvy.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Removal|An icon representing the keyword Cleanse]] [[:Crowd control#Removal|cleanses]] himself of all [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] and gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] 35% '''bonus''' movement speed for a duration.
description.text: Active: Garen cleanses himself of all slows and gains  35% bonus movement speed for a duration.

description2.raw: Additionally, '''Garen''' empowers his next [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] within 4.5 seconds to have an [[File:Relentless Force 2.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|An icon representing the keyword Uncancellable windup]] [[:Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|uncancellable windup]], [[File:Bear Stance.png|20px|link=Dash#Lunge|An icon representing the keyword Lunge]] [[:Dash#Lunge|lunge]] at the target, deal '''bonus''' physical damage, and [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Silence|An icon representing the keyword Silence]] [[:Silence|silence]] them for 1.5 seconds.
description2.text: Additionally, Garen empowers his next basic attack within 4.5 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, lunge at the target, deal bonus physical damage, and silence them for 1.5 seconds.

description3.raw: ''Decisive Strike [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Garen's''' basic attack timer.''
description3.text: Decisive Strike resets Garen's basic attack timer.

leveling2.raw:
'''Bonus Physical Damage:'''
30 / 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 (+ 50% AD)

notes.raw: * The enhanced attack will apply other [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects and can [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically strike]] as normal (the bonus damage does not). ** The bonus damage will also apply [[File:Life steal icon.svg|15px|link=Life steal]] life steal. ** The bonus damage is applied to [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]]. * ''Decisive Strike'' locks '''Garen''' out of using basic attacks for a short period of time. This is shortened with [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] attack speed. * The enhanced attack will still complete and hit the target even if they become [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]] during the [[:Attack speed#Windup|attack's windup]]. * ''Decisive Strike'' will not prevent the reapplication of [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] (e.g. the persistent slow from [[File:Trundle Pillar of Ice.png|20xpx|border|link=Trundle#Pillar of Ice|An icon for Trundle's ability Pillar of Ice]] [[Trundle#Pillar of Ice|Pillar of Ice]] will be immediately reapplied after removal if '''Garen''' is still within its [[area of effect]]). * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will only negate the [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Silence|An icon representing the keyword Silence]] [[:Silence|silence]]. * ''Decisive Strike's'' [[File:Bear Stance.png|20px|link=Dash#Lunge|An icon representing the keyword Lunge]] [[:Dash#Lunge|lunge]] can pass very thin terrain and will otherwise not be able to. In any case, '''Garen''' will still hit his target.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0qi54mu_gxg]
notes.text:
The enhanced attack will apply other on-hit effects and can critically strike as normal (the bonus damage does not).
* The bonus damage will also apply  life steal.
* The bonus damage is applied to structures.
Decisive Strike locks Garen out of using basic attacks for a short period of time. This is shortened with  attack speed.
The enhanced attack will still complete and hit the target even if they become untargetable during the attack's windup.
Decisive Strike will not prevent the reapplication of slows (e.g. the persistent slow from Pillar of Ice will be immediately reapplied after removal if Garen is still within its area of effect).
Spell shield will only negate the silence.
Decisive Strike's lunge can pass very thin terrain and will otherwise not be able to. In any case, Garen will still hit his target.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0qi54mu_gxg]
